input: Two sibling CNFs A,B on the same post-pivot variable universe, plus the parent only for final rank/replay verification.
algorithm: Canonicalize clauses and compute the clause symmetric difference D=A triangle B.
Build the variable co-occurrence graph using only clauses in D and take connected components.
Require every component to have size at most fixed b=5 and require the components to cover the active variables. Otherwise return NO_RULE_APPLICABLE.

For each component V_i and each transport direction, enumerate all signed permutations of V_i to itself (at most b!*2^b). Keep only maps satisfying all target clauses whose variables lie wholly in V_i against source clauses on V_i.

Build the component interaction graph from clauses spanning more than one component. Require it to be a path and every cross-clause to touch exactly two adjacent components. Otherwise return NO_RULE_APPLICABLE.
For each path edge, compute compatibility of candidate maps by exact clause-image/subsumption verification on all cross-clauses for that edge.
Run dynamic programming along the path. A surviving state sequence yields one global block-preserving signed permutation transport.

Verify the assembled transport globally, compute/verify the retained-child rank, and safe-delete the transported source sibling only if SAT(source)=>SAT(target) and the required rank drop/terminal condition holds.

complexity.path_dp: O(r*C^2*q) for r blocks, constant C<=3840 and bounded per-edge clause work q on the R44BX family; more generally polynomial in encoded input size for fixed b.

r44bx_family_theorem.symmetric_difference: All 12(k-1) orbit connector clauses and all common local clauses cancel between siblings. In every block D contains exactly the four pivot-dependent binary clauses {-x1 OR x4, x3 OR -x4, -x5 OR -x6, x3 OR x6} up to local renaming/sign convention.
r44bx_family_theorem.block_recovery: Those four clauses have a connected variable graph on all five local variables, while no D-clause crosses blocks. Therefore the connected components of D are exactly the k five-variable blocks.
r44bx_family_theorem.interaction_recovery: The surviving common nonlocal clauses are exactly the connector orbits between adjacent blocks, hence the recovered interaction graph is a path.
r44bx_family_theorem.local_search: The valid B->A local R44BP transport is found by the constant exhaustive local map enumeration; the algorithm does not receive pi as input.
r44bx_family_theorem.global_search: The repeated orbit connectors make the local choices compatible; path DP recovers a globally valid transport without enumerating its 5k-variable support.
r44bx_family_theorem.rank_effect: parent delta*=15k-13, retained child delta*=13k-12, strict drop 2k-1
r44bx_family_theorem.coverage: all k>=2 members of the explicit R44BX orbit-coupled family

next_exact_frontier: Construct or analyze critical siblings whose symmetric-difference components themselves grow/unboundedly couple, or whose component interaction graph defeats bounded-width compatibility DP, while preserving exact nonterminal rank growth and avoiding already-known terminal/quotient escapes.
